title: Getting started's header button is a two-way switch: Hide from account menu / Show in account menu, the screen stays open, and the account menu row comes back at once
steps: S1: run the tracy-onboard mount, menu-row and surface tests (node:test, jsdom page, fake /api/onboarding doors) and the tracy-web onboarding door test (Postgres).

S2: the end-to-end form: open Getting started, press Hide from account menu (the screen stays, the button reads Show in account menu), press it again, open the account menu: the Getting started row is there without a reload.
expect: Not hidden: [data-action='hide-menu'] reads 'Hide from account menu' (aria-label the same, data-state='shown', title mentions Settings › Help & about). Pressing it posts /api/onboarding/menu-hide only, never POST /api/onboarding; the screen stays open.

Hidden: the same button reads 'Show in account menu' (data-state='hidden', title 'Puts the Getting started row back in the account menu.'); pressing it posts /api/onboarding/menu-show and the account flag is cleared; the screen stays open.
An account that hid the row opens the screen on 'Show in account menu'. A refused door (403) keeps the screen and the button says what the account says.
The account menu row goes on Hide and comes back with its count on Show, without a reload.
accountStore.showMenu posts /api/onboarding/menu-show with the session cookie, never rejects, warns once; the desktop surface sends both to the account door.

POST /api/onboarding/menu-show answers {menuHiddenAt: null} and clears the flag (GET reads null; a later hide records a new time); 401 NOT_SIGNED_IN without a session, 403 CSRF_ORIGIN from a sibling host; one account never shows another's row.

tests: the header: "Hide from account menu" records the flag and keeps the screen; the button becomes "Show in account menu", which clears it
the header: an account that hid the row opens the screen on "Show in account menu"
the header: on a desktop app the toggle goes to the account door; a refused door (403) keeps the screen and says the flag did not change
the row opens the screen; "Hide from account menu" there takes the row away and "Show in account menu" brings it back, without a reload
showMenu posts to /api/onboarding/menu-show with the session cookie
showMenu never fails the caller: a refused door and no network both resolve, warned once
the desktop surface: hideMenu and showMenu go to the account door
menu-show: clears a hide so the row comes back; a later hide records a new time; showing twice is harmless
menu-show: 401 without a session, 403 from a sibling host, and one account never shows another
menu-show: a session whose account has no row yet answers null

fence: the menu flag lives on the account behind two doors (hide, show); the button never closes the screen and draws what the account answers after the press
